verdict.rationale: Vapi has a dedicated first-party docs page for background speech denoising under assistant conversation-behavior settings, and it says the feature filters out unwanted sounds while users speak. That is the story's core capability. Missing for 10: details of how to enable or tune it (config fields, filter types or levels), evidence of its effect on transcription or agent coherence in noisy calls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
